calendar_support_definition.outside_calendar_support: compatibility alias for zero_any_history_calendar_support; zero does not establish adequate support
calendar_support_definition.zero_any_history_calendar_support: count of candidate attempts with zero pure-plan provider/calendar exposures through model cutoff
calendar_support_definition.weak_recent_calendar_support: count of candidate attempts failing >=100 pure exposures total and >=1 recent month containing >=100 exposures within last two calendar months through cutoff
calendar_support_definition.recent_months: two calendar months ending in cutoff month; latest month can be partial (February + March through March 30 for April model)
calendar_support_definition.restriction: exposure-based sensitivity only, no response outcomes used and no causal guarantee
